text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After training, I visit the library to do
some
research.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The world is so marvelous! ☆ Life is
marvelous! ★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... The day's almost over, but
you're still as
happy as ever...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Don't you feel marvelous today? I'm
feeling quite
marvelous, myself! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah... I'd say I'm feeling the same
as usual.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What are you writing? "Marvelous
World..."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: It's my Marvelous World Plan!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The world is filled with marvelous things!

However, no one seems to realize it! It's
such a
shame!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uh, it feels too late to ask, but I'm not
quite sure
what you mean by
"marvelous."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous means something that
astounds you!
Miracles, happiness, good
fortune! These are
marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Think for a moment. In the beginning,
there was
the big bang, right? Do you
know what the
chances of the Earth
forming were? One in ten to
the
hundred-and-fifty-thousandth power!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And the chances that life would spring
up was
only one in ten to the
forty-thousandth power!
What else can
you call that besides an absolute

miracle?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And to think that Umamusume came to
exist on
top of that! No words can
describe how marvelous
it is! ☆ This is all
to say that—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Er, sorry. I'm really not following you at
all...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm getting pretty sleepy all of
a
sudden... for some... reason...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Where am I?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, Nature! ☆ This is the
Marvelous
Dimension! ★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Are you in search of glimmering
marvelousness?
Or perhaps pure
marvelousness?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uh? Actually, I don't think I'm in search
of ei—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Wow! You're so honest! So cool! So brave!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I shall grant you a reward! ☆ For such
honesty, I
bestow upon you the world's
most radiant
marvelousness! ★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Look, I still don't get what you're
rambling on
about. This is actually kind
of cree—wait! Am I
dreaming?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Uh, huh? Looks like I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Good morning, Nature! ★ You
looked so
marvelous while you were
asleep! ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
All my talk of marvelous things must
have
soothed you into a marvelous
slumber. ☆
Ahaha! ★ Ahahaha! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Marvelousness... Scary stuff.
